measurements.name: gnd_min

measurements.name: vcd_max

measurements.name: vcd_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran vcd_min MIN par('v(vc)-v(gnd_d)') FROM=180u TO=260u

measurements.name: outd_max
measurements.spice: .meas tran outd_max MAX par('v(out)-v(gnd_d)') FROM=180u TO=260u

measurements.name: outd_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran outd_min MIN par('v(out)-v(gnd_d)') FROM=180u TO=260u

measurements.name: outd_avg
